div.div:
Full payment cycle
① BasketCheckoutEvent → creates the Payment
② CDC publishes PaymentRequestedEvent
③ Gateway decides and publishes the outcome
④ Payment consumers apply it to the table
⑤ Ordering consumes the same outcome in parallel
